targets.text: Colleague represents model-bound agents: a typed AgentProfile (purpose, lobes role, authority ceiling, validated tool profile) with per-invocation identity + context manifest + tool-surface digest; subagents are explicit agents that may bind a different lobes role/model; agents exchange typed attributable messages (delegate/ask/inform/challenge/handoff/return); the reference topology is Talker=senses (Gemma 4 12B), Worker=worker (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NOT the coder), Thinker/Coder=cortex (Qwen 3.8 27B) — and when the worker role is not ready (today), cortex carries every purpose under a RECORDED fallback, subagents still spawn; byte-identical when unarmed
an armed run on today's rig (worker not ready) completes with every invocation attributed and a recorded fallback, AND an unarmed run is byte-identical — both demonstrated, not asserted

an AgentProfile (agent_id, purpose, model_role, resolved_model, tool_profile, authority_profile, parent_agent_id, task_id) becomes a first-class typed record; today the nearest structures are WorkerConfig/SeatConfig/EvaluationSeats (config.py:2671-2745) and roles.Role(name, prompt_fragment, tool_allowlist, skill_subset, read_only) (roles.py:27-57) — no per-invocation agent identity exists; the durable resolution stays lobes role→RoleInfo(model, endpoint, path, context, ready, responsibilities, forbidden_responsibilities) via lobes.resolve_roles (lobes.py:154-171, :256)

AgentProfile is a frozen dataclass with a schema version; vendor model names never appear in its code; resolved_model is trace data filled from RoleInfo.model — a profile validates without any network (gateway double)

with three_tier armed and the gateway's worker role not ready, _resolve_worker REFUSES (config.py:1296-1302 'advertises no ready worker role', never falls back to cortex per :1237-1243): today's .colleague/config.json is {lobes: http://localhost:8001, three_tier: true} and the live gateway advertises worker=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 ready:false loaded:true — so 'colleague config show' and doctor provider_config FAIL right now; the operator's stated state 'worker is off, cortex does everything' has no armed mode that expresses it
the refusal is reproduced verbatim ('advertises no ready worker role') against the live gateway before the fix, and the 2026-08-21 /capabilities dump is attached to the delivery doc

worker-absent handling is an explicit, recorded fallback — never silent, never a refusal of all work: when the armed reference mode finds the worker role absent/not ready, every worker-purpose invocation is carried by the thinker/coder (cortex) agent with the fallback recorded on the agent identity (e.g. fallback_from_role=worker) and on the artifact; Qwen-required coding work never downgrades to worker (issue #411 acceptance 'Lightning can be unavailable with explicit fallback/escalation')

the fallback is visible on THREE surfaces — the invocation record, TaskResult (omit-when-unarmed), and a doctor/config-show line — and there is no code path where a worker-purpose call silently runs on cortex without the marker

no automatic per-turn task→model routing: model switching happens only through explicit delegation/handoff by an agent, recorded on the ledger — config._model_pin_source documents 'no code path reads task content to pick a model' (config.py:1703-1727), backpressure.py:35 'never selects a different model or backend (not a router)', CLAUDE.md v1 scope: anything beyond the ten increments is the excluded router; #411's own acceptance says 'model switching happens through explicit delegation/handoff, not invisible per-turn substitution'
a grep-guard asserts no code path branches on task/instruction content to pick a model; the only model switch is a ledgered delegation record naming the requested profile

a subagent can bind a DIFFERENT lobes role/endpoint than its parent: today run_subagent inherits the parent EngineConfig via dataclasses.replace overriding only model/role (+ caps), while base_url/api_key are inherited untouched (subagents.py:468-489) so a child cannot target another role's dial; the child engine wheel is already swappable (registry.load, subagents.py:429-435)

a child bound to another role is dialed through lobes.resolve_role_base_url exactly like a TAE seat, inherits NO parent api_key when the role's endpoint differs (same-origin key hygiene #348), and mock implements the same ChildSpec field

delegation can only NARROW authority and tools: a child's effective tool surface is a subset of its parent's, independent of the child's model; today this holds for Role allow-lists enforced on both sides (tools.curate_schemas :555 + ToolExecutor(allowlist=) :736/:819) and overlays that change only the prompt never the allowlist (roles.py:220-229); caps MAX_SUBAGENT_DEPTH/FANOUT/TOTAL (config.py:339-341) stay
a property test over random parent/child profiles: child effective tools ⊆ parent effective tools, child authority ceiling ≤ parent's, regardless of the child's model

typed, attributable agent-to-agent messages (delegate / ask / inform / challenge / handoff / return) become first-class runtime records on the append-only ledger: today the ONLY child→parent channel is SubResult(task_id, engine, model, status, summary, changed_files, usage, role, parent) rendered to the parent as a string (contract.py:337-366, tools.py:1343-1345); the precedent for typed attributable records is ledger.LedgerEntry(kind, thought_id, action_id, detail, seat, model, seq) with closed kind/seat vocabularies (ledger.py:99, :80-86)

every message type is in a closed vocabulary, refuses unknown types whole (the MoveResult refuse/degrade shape), carries from/to agent ids + seq on the ledger, and has no field for rationale/chain-of-thought

the effective tool surface is computed as an intersection (available ∩ model-supported ∩ purpose ∩ policy ∩ environment ∩ approvals), validated at agent creation, and its digest recorded per invocation: today narrowing is role allow-list (tools.py:555), three-tier worker.tools narrowing (tools.py:594 narrow_role_by_tool_set, ceiling=role, empty refused lattice.py:364), executor refusal (tools.py:819), policy.check_run_command token gate (policy.py:200), hooks pre_tool allow/deny/rewrite (hooks.py:85) — there is NO model-supported dimension, NO per-model schema tailoring (#89 unbuilt per docs/specs/2026-06-03 spec :11,:44) and NO tool-surface digest (only configevents.effective_digest over config events, configevents.py:215)

the effective surface is computed once at agent creation from the six dimensions, its sha256 digest lands on the invocation record, and narrowing can only shrink it; an empty result refuses whole (lattice.py:364 precedent)

the Worker purpose profile does NOT carry generic code-authoring mutation tools (write_file/edit_file) by default: read/list/search, run_tests, separately-approved run_command, memory recall, delegate; today three-tier repoints the ACTING dial to the worker with the full curated surface (config.py:1185-1217 _resolve_acting_dial), i.e. the worker IS the coder — the exact topology #411 supersedes

negative test on mock and vllm-openai: a Worker-profile agent's offered schemas and executor allow-list contain neither write_file nor edit_file; run_command remains approval-gated by token; delegate is available

the landed #397 contracts are reused, not replaced: Thought(thought_id, intent, why, supersedes, observation_refs, constraints, success_conditions, uncertainties, version) (thought.py:308), ActionProposal(thought_id, action_id, proposed_action, expected_effect, evidence_refs, consequential) (actionproposal.py:85), Evaluation(thought_id, action_id, verdict, route, reason, evidence_gaps, version) with closed routes execute|rethink|replan|block (evaluation.py:235,:179-201), EVALUATOR_BOUNDARIES (tae_control.py:23-29), host-owned consequential classification (tae_loop.py:624); alignment is never permission; evaluator ≠ distiller
Thought/ActionProposal/Evaluation/LedgerEntry schemas are unchanged or versioned additively; evaluator verdicts still never write memory or grant permission

every agent invocation records identity + context manifest (agent_id, purpose, resolved model/revision, tool-surface digest, ledger_digest, working_set/peer-message refs, token_estimate, truncated, parent/delegation lineage): today Step is {index, tool, arguments, result, ok} (contract.py:1189-1196), tokens are work-item aggregates (Usage, WorkStats), FinishRecord(seat, finish_reason, state, truncated) is per seat once per item (contract.py:1212-1216); per-call records exist only for side lanes (DeepthinkCall, SensesRecord) — there is no per-invocation manifest
tokens on the manifest are labelled by source (/tokenize exact vs chars estimate) and never presented as usage; usage stays exactly the wire value per the repo convention

the agent runtime lands as a NEW boundary (colleague/agents/: profile, runtime, tools, messages, delegation) with thin seam calls from loop.py — not more loop.py branches: loop.py is 4951 lines, zero #399 extraction has landed (git log --grep=399 empty), and the second-engine pattern is already triplicated as replace(EngineConfig)+engine.make_complete(cfg, tools=[]) in deepthink.py:64, senses.py:669, tae_loop.py:214 — that seam becomes AgentProfile→EngineConfig
loop.py's diff in this arc is wiring only (seam calls + one mode check); tests/test_boundary.py allow-lists are unchanged; colleague/agents/ imports no subprocess and opens no socket

Task/TaskResult, the Engine ABC (engine.py:39 work/drive/make_complete/make_count_tokens/system_prompt), the colleague.engines plugin group and all-engines parity are preserved; mock implements every new record identically; new fields are omit-when-None so unarmed serialization is byte-identical (the contract.py:1308-1345 convention)
Task/TaskResult/Engine ABC unchanged except additive omit-when-None fields; the mock parity suite's pinned key set is byte-identical when unarmed

Qwen 3.8 runtime truthfulness rides along where the agent boundary touches it: empty content + finish_reason=length is NOT treated as degradation today (vllm_openai.py:273 carries it raw; loop._handle_no_tool_turn :2021 treats it as an ordinary no-tool turn; only finishstate.classify_finish_state :112 sees it at run end) and reasoning tokens are not recorded (vllm_openai.py:261-263, measured as reasoning_chars/bytes) — an agent invocation record must mark such a turn truncated rather than silently continuing

an empty-content finish_reason=length turn is recorded as truncated on the invocation record and triggers the existing degradation/retry lane instead of the no-tool nudge; pinned by a streaming test on a real os.pipe

the Talker IS the existing senses role — structurally tools-off (Engine.make_complete(senses_config, tools=[]) at every call site senses.py:669,:744,:807,:1104,:1237,:1410; senses_moves imports neither subprocess nor ToolExecutor :34-39; tests/test_senses_cannot_act.py pins it), never task authority, removable in headless work (cortex-only mode is byte-identical, cortex-senses.md:143-145); the Talker agent profile adds identity/manifest and typed messaging ON TOP of this, never repo tools or approval power
senses keeps tools=[] at every call site and the talker profile cannot hold write tools by construction (profile validation refuses)

the reference agents are NAMED BY LOBES ROLE (Talker=senses, Worker=worker, Thinker/Coder=cortex) and never by model family: the zero-model-ids boundary is test-pinned (tests/test_deepthink_config.py:401,415 bans 'gemma'/'qwen'/'lobes' in config code; cortex-senses.md:56-60 'no vendor model string appears in colleague/ code'); Gemma/Lightning/Qwen are the RIG's answers (live /capabilities), trace data on the identity record, not authority
Talker=senses, Worker=worker, Thinker/Coder=cortex are the only role names in code; the reference model table lives in docs + the lobes advert; the vendor-name grep guard covers colleague/agents/

the existing one-directional senses→cortex move channel (MOVE_SCHEMA + MoveResult{move, outcome, refused, degraded, detail}, senses_moves.py:186-210,:275-305) is the precedent the typed agent messages generalise: messages are attributable records (from/to agent_id, type, subject, content, evidence_refs, requested_response), carry conclusions/evidence only — never hidden chain-of-thought — and the Talker's reply/clarify/narrate moves stay display-only

the Talker's reply/clarify/narrate outputs are display-only and can never appear as a delegate/handoff authority; senses stays tools=[] at every call site after the change (test_senses_cannot_act.py still passes)

all-engines parity stays the hard gate: tests/test_e2e_mock.py pins the exact TaskResult key set {task_id, status, summary, changed_files, steps, usage, stats, finish_states, artifacts_path, error, branch, pr_url, hook_firings, command, not_finished, stopped_without_finish} (:268-285,:311-330) with optional blocks OMIT-when-None, the identical base-six+chassis tool surface on every engine (:168-196, vllm_openai.SCHEMAS is SCHEMAS), and SubResult field parity batch vs sequential (:466-495) — every #411 record is omit-when-unarmed and mock-implemented
tests/test_e2e_mock.py passes unchanged; new blocks appear only when agents is armed

the thread/subprocess boundary is unchanged unless explicitly joined: _SUBPROCESS_ALLOWED (tests/test_boundary.py:526-545, 17 modules) and _THREADS_ALLOWED = {subagents.py, cli/_commands/_input_line.py, realtime.py} (:765-771) are bidirectional guards; agent messaging and delegation are in-process typed records — no socket, daemon, transport, MCP client, or new thread consumer
tests/test_boundary.py passes unchanged — no new subprocess/thread consumer

a durable, append-only TASK LEDGER under .colleague/ (e.g. .colleague/ledger/<task_id>.jsonl) becomes the shared source of continuity: events for the immutable operator request, accepted constraints, acceptance criteria, plan nodes (id/status/depends_on/evidence_refs), decisions, open loops, evidence/tool-result refs, working-set refs, changed paths, verification, agent messages, delegations; a derived TaskSnapshot (with state_digest + authority_digest) is reconstructable from the events + repo evidence; today nothing of this exists — persistence is artifact JSON + trace JSONL (artifact.py:117), chain state is in-memory (chain.py:245-253), and the only append-only streams are the episode-scoped evaluation ledger (ledger.py) and config_events (contract.py:1655-1675)

the ledger file is append-only (no rewrite path), replay-deterministic (same events → same snapshot + digest), schema-versioned, and the evaluation ledger / config_events are referenced or folded — never duplicated

authority and task state SURVIVE compaction, continuation, backgrounding and every --until-done episode: approval/policy, --no-pr, mode, role/profile, constraints, acceptance, changed paths, failed checks, unresolved plan items and promised follow-ups cannot disappear; continuation (work --continue / session /continue) REHYDRATES from the ledger snapshot instead of the prose recap it uses today (continuation.py:25 + escalation.build_continuation :187); latest explicit operator input outranks every summary and recalled record; stale or contradictory state refuses or routes to rethink instead of silently merging

work --continue after a SIGTERM cut rehydrates from the ledger with 0 lost changed paths / open loops / acceptance / authority flags, and a compaction drops 0 plan nodes — both as regression tests, the SIGTERM one on a real os.pipe (#410 shape)

per-agent bounded CONTEXT RECONSTRUCTION replaces transcript windowing for agent invocations: each turn is assembled from explicit layers — nucleus (active thought/mission, constraints, acceptance, authority, active plan node, unresolved failures), working set (recent tool evidence + files/symbols for the next action), retrieved procedures/lessons (small top-k, token-capped), archive references (ids/digests loaded on demand) — purpose-specific per agent; the manifest records ledger_digest, nucleus/working_set/retrieved_memory/peer_message refs, token_estimate, truncated; no full-transcript copying between agents; today context.window_messages (context.py:232) drops oldest segments of one running transcript
two agents on one task get different reconstructions from one ledger; every manifest ref resolves to a ledger id; the unarmed loop still uses window_messages byte-identically

peer claims keep provenance and rank below evidence: operator input > current repo/tool evidence > accepted task facts > peer claims > recalled memory; a peer agent's statement is promoted into accepted shared state only through the same evidence/policy mechanisms as any other conclusion; cross-model disagreement (a challenge message and its answer) is RECORDED on the ledger, never flattened into consensus
an inform/challenge never mutates accepted facts by itself; both sides of a challenge are present in the ledger; a later operator instruction outranks a peer claim in the reconstruction

colleague operators on the Spark rig with lobes armed (today: cortex Qwen 3.8 ready, senses Gemma ready, worker Lightning advertised not-ready), mesh peers reading the artifact/ledger, and the lobes-cli side of #187 that advertises the roles; plus every operator NOT arming the mode, who must see byte-identical behaviour
the spec names lobes-cli#187 as the owner of role adverts and cites the 2026-08-21 /capabilities probe; unarmed operators are named as readers whose behaviour is byte-identical

an armed operator runs 'colleague work' on today's rig and gets: every invocation attributed (agent_id, purpose, role, resolved model, tool-surface digest, context manifest, lineage), subagents that may bind a different lobes role with a child surface ⊆ parent, typed delegate/ask/inform/challenge/handoff/return records on an append-only ledger, a Worker profile with no generic write tools, a Talker that is the tools-off senses, a cortex-backed fallback recorded wherever a role is absent, continuation that rehydrates from the ledger, and per-agent bounded reconstruction — while an unarmed operator sees byte-identical behaviour and the pinned artifact key set

each clause of the after-state maps to at least one confirmed requirement with a test (identity → c13, cross-role child → c7, messages → c9, worker profile → c11, talker → c19, fallback → c4/c28, rehydrate → c35, reconstruction → c36)

the 2026-08-20 benchmark priced the current multi-seat topology at 100% failure vs 100% success for solo cortex on the same task, with every failure in the seams (#409/#410) — and the rolled Qwen 3.8 is both the strongest coder and reasoning-heavy (88–93% of completion spend), so coding authority must sit with it while routine/inspection/presence work can move to cheaper minds ONLY if every hop is attributable, bounded and recorded; meanwhile today's config.json refuses outright because the worker is off
the benchmark figures (solo cortex 100% / three-tier 0%; 88–93% reasoning spend) are cited from their recorded sources (memory note 2026-08-20, live-testing.md rows 34–35), not restated from memory

unarmed = byte-identical: with 'agents' unset the full suite passes and tests/test_e2e_mock.py's pinned TaskResult key set has 0 additions; every new record is omit-when-unarmed and implemented on mock and vllm-openai alike
measured by running the suite + a key-set diff, not by inspection

attribution is complete: in an armed run 100% of model invocations (main, subagent, talker, evaluator) carry agent_id, purpose, model_role, resolved_model, tool_surface_digest, a context manifest and parent/delegation lineage on the artifact; and the negative authority test holds — a Worker-profile agent is offered 0 of {write_file, edit_file}, and in 100% of delegations the child's effective tool set ⊆ the parent's
measured over the artifact + ledger of a real armed run, plus the negative authority test on both engines

worker-absent works today: against a gateway double mirroring the 2026-08-21 advert (worker ready:false) a work item with ≥1 subagent completes with status ok and every worker-purpose invocation recorded as cortex-backed fallback — 0 refusals; and one LIVE run on the Spark rig with agents armed completes end to end
the gateway double mirrors the saved 2026-08-21 advert byte-for-byte; the live row names the task id

continuity survives the cut: a run cut by SIGTERM (#410 shape) and resumed with work --continue rehydrates a snapshot whose changed_paths / open_loops / acceptance / authority fields equal the pre-cut snapshot (0 lost items), and a fillline compaction drops 0 plan nodes; reconstruction keeps ordinary turns bounded — manifest token_estimate < 50% of the seat's advertised context on every ordinary turn of the live run
the SIGTERM test uses a real os.pipe stream; the 50% bound is read from the live run's manifests

promotion is evidence-gated: before agents mode becomes default, a matched experiment (solo-cortex legacy vs agents mode, same brief, same rig, pre-registered bars) reports quality, completion, latency, tokens per model, tool calls per model, escalation rate, invalid tool calls and corrections — recorded as a docs/live-testing.md row; until then the mode ships opt-in only
bars are committed before the arms run; the row records both arms' numbers even if agents mode loses

no transcript copying between agents and no KV/hidden-state sharing; each agent receives a bounded, purpose-specific reconstruction (c36) — the seat's context window follows the lobes advert (the operator is moving cortex to 1,048,576) and is a CEILING/escape hatch, never the default fill target; the legacy UNARMED loop keeps context.window_messages (context.py:232) and _DEFAULT_CONTEXT_BUDGET (config.py:86) untouched

armed: every ordinary-turn manifest token_estimate stays below 50% of the seat's advertised context (the h31 measurement, read from the live run); unarmed: tests/test_doc_config_drift.py:34 and the context windowing tests pass unchanged

the task ledger lives at the OPERATOR repo on isolated runs — .colleague/ledger/<task_id>.jsonl resolved the way the flight plane already is (task.flight_repo_path or task.repo_path, loop.py:2161-2172) so a throwaway worktree never takes the ledger with it; it is local-only (gitignored by /.colleague/* at .gitignore:247, never committed); colleague clean / the handoff.py reap (scoped strictly to colleague/* refs + .colleague/ artifacts, handoff.py:697) gains the ledger dir for FINISHED/orphaned tasks and never reaps a live one
an isolated run's ledger path equals flight_repo_path-resolution; 'git status' is clean after an armed run; clean reaps only finished-task ledgers

the effective tool surface is enforced TWO-SIDED for every agent — the offered schemas (tools.curate_schemas :555) AND the executor allow-list (ToolExecutor(allowlist=) :736/:819) — and composes with, never bypasses, the config-lifecycle tool_set narrowing (tools.narrow_role_by_tool_set :594); EVERY spawn wiring site (work.py:1290-1297 make_spawn/make_batch_spawn and any other caller) carries the agent profile so no spawn path yields an unidentified child
a Worker-profile agent that emits a write_file call is refused by the executor even if a schema slipped through; every make_spawn caller passes a profile (grep + test)

delegation lifecycle is ledgered so a half-completed delegation is visible: a delegate event is appended BEFORE the child spawns and a return event after it; at rehydration a delegate without a return is an OPEN LOOP naming the salvageable sub/<id> worktree/branch (the existing 'spend-dead subagents leave salvageable worktrees' fact); a handoff transfers ledger ownership of a plan node ONLY — repo writes stay in the sub/<id> worktree + the sequential merge child (subagents.py:675-724), never a second write path
a parent killed mid-child rehydrates with the open delegation + sub/<id> branch named; handoff never changes which worktree writes

operator input that arrives MID-RUN — flight guidance, senses guide_cortex, talk — is appended as an operator_input ledger event (not only injected as chat text, loop._fold_flight_chat :2129) so reconstruction ranks it above every peer claim and summary (c37) and rehydration replays it
mid-run guidance appears as an operator_input event and outranks an earlier peer inform in the rebuilt context

single writer per ledger file: each agent/task id appends only to ITS OWN ledger; cross-references are by id; a parent appends child refs after the join in the main thread (the subagents.py:800-869 collect-after-join pattern); the append path takes the POSIX-guarded fcntl advisory lock worktrees.py already uses (:46, :138-169) so --background children, the resident embed and width>1 subagent threads never interleave a file; no new thread consumer joins tests/test_boundary.py
a concurrency test on a real file: N threads × M appends → N×M intact lines; non-POSIX degrades with a warning

agent messaging is BOUNDED: a per-task message budget (MAX_AGENT_MESSAGES, the _AgentBudget shape subagents.py:246-289) caps ask/challenge/inform traffic so a ping-pong never runs unbounded; exhaustion is recorded honestly on the ledger and TaskResult.warnings; delegation depth/fan-out/total caps (config.py:339-341) stay as they are
a scripted ask↔challenge loop halts at MAX_AGENT_MESSAGES with a TaskResult.warnings entry; the cap is a constant, never model-chosen

rehydration fails CLOSED and LOUD: an unknown ledger schema version, a corrupt or truncated tail, or a state_digest mismatch refuses the ledger path with a recorded warning and falls back to the existing prose-recap continuation (continuation.py:25) — never a traceback, never a silent merge of stale state
truncated tail / bumped schema / digest mismatch each yield a warning + prose-recap continuation; work --continue exits 0

peer-message content is model-authored text: it enters another agent's context only under the peer-claims rank of c37, labelled as a peer claim with its from-agent id, never as system or operator text; the raw operator request stays verbatim and separate (the #397 preserved-input invariant); the ledger is local-only (gitignored) so no agent message or tool-result ref is ever committed
an inform containing tool-call markup or 'operator:' text renders as labelled peer text and executes nothing; git status clean after the run

observability: doctor gains an 'agents' group (mode armed; each reference role's advert ready/absent; the fallbacks that will fire) and config show prints the mode, mirroring the three_tier_armed/three_tier_gateway lines; the invocation records ride the artifact; the cockpit/tui surfacing of agent identity is parked, not built
doctor with a worker-absent gateway double prints the fallback line; unarmed prints nothing for the group

tasks.summary: t1 agents/profile.py — AgentProfile + purposes + role map + fallback resolution
acceptance_criteria: colleague/agents/__init__.py + colleague/agents/profile.py exist; AgentProfile is a frozen dataclass (agent_id, purpose, model_role, resolved_model, tool_profile, authority_profile, parent_agent_id, task_id, fallback_from_role, schema_version) with to_dict/from_dict round-trip

PURPOSES is the closed set {talker, worker, thinker_coder}; PURPOSE_ROLE maps talker→senses, worker→worker, thinker_coder→cortex; resolve_profile(purpose, roles) returns the role's model when ready, else the cortex model with fallback_from_role set — pure function, no network (tests use a RoleInfo double mirroring the 2026-08-21 advert)
tests/test_agents_profile.py passes; it includes a grep guard that no file under colleague/agents/ contains gemma|qwen|nemotron|lightning (case-insensitive)
tasks.instruction: New package colleague/agents/. Model on roles.Role (roles.py:27-57) and lobes.RoleInfo (lobes.py:154-171). Purpose before tools: the profile names a tool_profile id (string) resolved by t2, never a tool list. No imports from loop.py. Keep it under 250 lines.

tasks.summary: t2 agents/tools.py — ToolProfile records, effective-surface intersection, digest, the three purpose profiles
acceptance_criteria: colleague/agents/tools.py defines ToolProfile(canonical_id, tool_class in {read, write, external, destructive}, required_approval: bool, inheritable: bool) for every name in tools.TOOL_NAMES + deepthink, reconciling roles._WRITE_TOOLS and tae_loop.CONSEQUENTIAL_TOOLS into the single tool_class field (subagent/subagents are class write; culture/devague external)

effective_tools(available, model_supported, purpose_tools, policy_tools, env_tools, approved_tools) returns the sorted intersection and tool_surface_digest(tools) = sha256 over the sorted names; an empty intersection raises EmptyToolSurface (refuse whole, lattice.py:364 precedent)

WORKER_TOOLS excludes write_file and edit_file and includes read_file, view_media, list_dir, run_tests, run_command, memory, subagent, subagents, finish; TALKER_TOOLS is empty; THINKER_CODER_TOOLS is the full base+chassis surface; tests/test_agents_tools.py proves each and that narrowing never adds a name
tasks.instruction: Pure module, no engine imports. tools.py:112 SCHEMAS is the available set (read names from tools.TOOL_NAMES at import — do not duplicate schemas). The digest must be stable across processes (sorted, utf-8). Two-sided ENFORCEMENT is wired in t15, not here.

tasks.summary: t3 agents/messages.py — typed agent messages + the per-task message budget
acceptance_criteria: AgentMessage(message_id, task_id, from_agent, to_agent, type, subject, content, evidence_refs, requested_response, seq) with MESSAGE_TYPES = frozenset({delegate, ask, inform, challenge, handoff, return}); validate_message refuses an unknown type or a missing from/to whole (MessageVerdict(allowed, reason)); the dataclass has no rationale/chain-of-thought field and to_dict emits none

MessageBudget(limit=MAX_AGENT_MESSAGES) charges atomically and refuses at the cap with reason 'message budget exhausted' (mirror subagents._AgentBudget :246-289); MAX_AGENT_MESSAGES is a constant in colleague/config.py next to MAX_SUBAGENT_TOTAL (config.py:339-341)

tests/test_agents_messages.py passes: closed vocabulary, refuse-whole, budget exhaustion, to_dict round-trip, and a test that message content containing tool-call markup stays inert data (senses_moves test_senses_cannot_act.py shape)
tasks.instruction: Model the refuse/degrade shape on senses_moves.MoveResult (senses_moves.py:186-210). Messages are in-process records destined for the ledger (t4) — no transport, no socket, no thread. Only touch config.py for the one constant line.

tasks.summary: t4 agents/state/ledger.py — append-only task ledger, snapshot, digests, locked append, fail-closed reader
